answer.answer: The Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 - Short-Term Training scheme serves people no longer in education or work who need an initial occupational skill [E01]. The scheme specifically targets "out-of-education candidates, school/college dropouts, and unemployed youth" [E01] and provides "free NSQF-aligned skill training ranging between 300 and 600 hours" along with "On-the-Job Training (OJT), an induction kit, assessment and certification, accidental insurance, and applicable allowances" [E01]. Candidates can be "looking for fresh skilling, re-skilling, or upskilling" [E01], making it suitable for those seeking initial occupational skills.

claim_to_evidence.claim: The scheme targets out-of-education candidates, school/college dropouts, and unemployed youth
Free NSQF-aligned skill training ranging between 300 and 600 hours is provided
On-the-Job Training, induction kit, assessment and certification are provided
